characters.name: Elenka
characters.tag_prompt: child, brown hair, two buns, freckles, big smile, yellow dress, white apron, flour on clothes
characters.desc_en: Elenka, an energetic smiling 8-year-old girl with brown hair in two buns, freckles, a yellow dress and a white apron dusted with flour

characters.name: Mopík
characters.tag_prompt: pug, fat dog, fawn fur, black muzzle, curly tail
characters.desc_en: Mopik, a chubby lazy fawn pug with a black wrinkly face and a curly tail

characters.name: Babička Lubomíra
characters.tag_prompt: old woman, grey hair, hair bun, glasses, floral dress, cardigan, smile
characters.desc_en: Grandma Lubomira, a cheerful plump 65-year-old woman with grey hair in a bun, round glasses, a floral dress and a cardigan

locations.tag_prompt: indoors, kitchen, old kitchen, wooden table, rolling pin, bowls, flour, sunlight
locations.desc_en: An old sunlit country kitchen, rolling pins and bowls on a wooden table, flour spilled all over the floor.

locations.tag_prompt: indoors, hallway, wooden floor, wicker basket, door, coat rack, warm lighting
locations.desc_en: The hallway of an old cottage with a wooden floor and an old wicker basket by the door.

panels.scene_en: a cozy old sunlit kitchen with rolling pins, mixing bowls and flour scattered everywhere, empty of people
Elenka stands on tiptoes on a wooden stool stretching up towards a high shelf, the pug lies under the table below

bubbles.speaker: elenka
bubbles.text: Mopíku, ještě kousek! Babiččin tajný recept na jahodový koláč musí být někde tady nahoře!

panels.scene_en: close-up of the pug lying on the floor with a dusting of white flour on his nose, sneezing and looking up hopefully, wagging his tail

bubbles.speaker: mopik
bubbles.translation: Raději mi hoď ten kousek másla!

panels.scene_en: the pug pushes his nose deep into an old wicker basket by the door in the hallway

bubbles.text: Mopík strčí čenich do starého proutěného koše.

panels.scene_en: the pug holds a yellowed rolled-up paper tied with a red ribbon in his mouth, Elenka claps her hands in delight

bubbles.speaker: elenka
bubbles.text: Ty jsi génius! Našel jsi ho! Babička bude koukat!

panels.scene_en: grandma comes into the hallway carrying a shopping bag, surprised and smiling

bubbles.speaker: babicka
bubbles.text: Co to tady vy dva vyvádíte?

bubbles.speaker: babicka
bubbles.text: Jéje, vy jste našli recept mé prababičky!

panels.scene_en: grandma holds the old recipe and laughs with Elenka while the pug sits proudly waiting for a reward
